project_name: Coven of Witches - Mystical Trick-Taking Card Game
theme: Cozy mystical candlelit witch's coven, deep velvet midnight purple, flickering warm amber candlelight, aged parchment cards, and glowing elemental alchemy

design_philosophy.core_aesthetic: Handcrafted occult grimoire meets cozy candlelit hearth table. Deep midnight obsidian purple surfaces, gold leaf filigree borders, glowing ethereal runes, and tactile playing cards fanned gracefully.
design_philosophy.anti_ai_rules: Strictly no generic blue SaaS buttons, no sterile flat white cards, no uniform square grids. Every card has botanical/occult corner pips, custom mystical SVG insignias, and an aged parchment cardstock feel with subtle inner vignette. Use rich atmospheric shadows and candle flame flickers.
design_philosophy.emotional_goal: Tactile tension and hearth-side intimacy. Players huddling around a shared screen passing the device, suspenseful trick reveals into a glowing central cauldron, dread when collecting fire/witches, and euphoric relief when passing penalty cards away.

screen_1_setup.name: The Summoning Circle (Setup)
elements: Interactive player count selector (3, 4, 5, or 6 witches)
Player name inputs with witch avatar badge selectors (Sorceress, Alchemist, Necromancer, Oracle, Druidess, Enchanter)
Passing cards rule toggle / preview (Passing cards to left/right/across based on player count)
Quick start presets ('Trio Coven', 'Quartet Gathering', 'Grand Sabbat (6)')
Audio / sound FX toggle switch with candle icon
Primary CTA button: 'Enter the Coven' (glowing amber flame border, pulse effect)

screen_2_pass_gate.name: Veil of Secrecy (Pass-Device Gate)
screen_2_pass_gate.purpose: Hides the previous player's hand completely for authentic pass-and-play local multiplayer.
screen_2_pass_gate.visuals: Full screen ethereal velvet shroud, centered glowing cauldron with animated smoke swirls, wax-sealed grimoire button.
elements: Witch avatar illustration for the upcoming player
Headline: 'Veil of Secrecy'
Prompt: 'Pass the device to [Player Name]'
Warning note: 'Ensure no wandering eyes peer at your cards...'
CTA button: 'Reveal My Hand (I am [Player Name])' with tactile click and card fan animation

screen_3_card_passing.name: The Coven Trade (Passing Phase)
screen_3_card_passing.rules: According to official Amigo rules: 3 players pass 3 cards to left, 4 players pass 3 cards (Round 1 left, Round 2 right, Round 3 across, Round 4 no pass), 5 players pass 2 cards, 6 players pass 1 card. The app dynamically handles this!
ui_mechanics: Prompt banner: 'Select {N} card(s) to curse/bless {Target Player Name}'
Tap cards in player's fanned hand to toggle selection (cards lift up by 24px with glowing amber border)
Confirm pass button: 'Seal and Pass Cards'
Once all players pass their cards, the hands update secretly and the first trick begins!

header_bar.top_left: Round & Trick counters (e.g., 'Round 2 • Trick 5/15') + active lead suit indicator badge
header_bar.center: Current turn alert: '[Player Name] is conjuring...'
header_bar.top_right: Scoreboard drawer toggle, Sound toggle, Rules Grimoire dialog button

opponents_roster.style: Avatars arranged along top/sides of table with fire points badge, remaining card count, and active turn highlight halo

central_cauldron_felt.style: Oval velvet play area ringed with runic gold border and a mystical cauldron in center. Played cards land in an orbital fanned circle pointing toward the center cauldron.
central_cauldron_felt.trick_cards: Each played card displays player's avatar chip, card face, and glow.
central_cauldron_felt.trick_winner_banner: When trick finishes: announcement badge showing '[Winner Name] claims the trick!' with a 1.5s inspection pause and cards swiping toward the winner's corner.

active_player_hand.style: Bottom docking area with cozy wooden/stone border. Cards fanned with overlap (`-space-x-8 sm:-space-x-12`).
active_player_hand.legal_play_highlights: Non-playable cards are dimmed (opacity 40%, desaturated), while legal cards (matching lead suit, or any card if void of lead suit) elevate on hover with a magical golden ring.
active_player_hand.one_touch_play: Tap card once to inspect/raise, second tap or swipe-up to throw card into the cauldron.

screen_5_round_scores.name: The Reckoning (Round Scoreboard)
elements: Breakdown of cards captured: Fire cards tally, Witch cards captured
Witch modifiers applied visually: e.g., Fire Witch doubling icon, Water Witch +5, Earth Witch -5 blessing, Air Witch canceling water/pygmy points
Fire Spell alert! If a player miraculously gathered all 14 fire cards, grand mystical animation triggers with points blasted to all opponents!
Cumulative Fire Points table with progress toward 70-point threshold bar
CTA: 'Commence Next Round'

screen_6_game_over.name: The Arch-Witch Crowning (Winner Screen)
screen_6_game_over.trigger: When any player reaches 70 or more fire points.
screen_6_game_over.outcome: Player with the FEWEST fire points is crowned Arch-Witch Supreme!
elements: Grand trophy podium with gold runic laurel
Winner witch avatar celebrating with shimmering stars
Full match summary table (Tricks won, witches captured, fire survived)
Actions: 'Play Again with Same Coven', 'New Players Setup', 'View Grimoire Stats'

screen_7_stats_and_grimoire.name: The Grimoire of Records (Local Stats)
elements: Lifetime games played, rounds survived, lowest score record
Player leaderboard sorted by win rate and fewest average fire points
Witch codex: interactive card gallery showing all 4 witches, pygmy queen, and wizards with lore descriptions

official_witches_card_rules_reference.deck_composition: 60 cards total: 4 suits (Red, Yellow, Blue, Green) each 1-14 (56 cards) + 4 Colorless Wizard cards (value 0).

card_points.red_cards: Each Red card (1 to 14) is worth 1 Fire penalty point (14 total fire cards).
card_points.fire_witch: Red 11: Worth 0 base points, but DOUBLES all fire cards collected by player in that round (up to max 15 points).
card_points.earth_witch: Green 11: Worth -5 Fire points (deducts up to 5 points, score cannot go below 0 for the round).
card_points.air_witch: Yellow 11: Neutralizes (cancels) the positive points from Water Witch (+5) and Pygmy Queen (+10) if the player took them.
card_points.wizard_0: Colorless 0: Worth 0 points. Can be played anytime. Follows no suit. Lowest card.

official_witches_card_rules_reference.shooting_the_moon_fire_spell: If a player collects ALL 14 RED CARDS in a single round, they score 0 points, and all other players receive 20 points! If that player also collected the Water Witch, others get 25 points; if they also collected Pygmy Queen, others get 30 points!
official_witches_card_rules_reference.trick_play_rules: Lead player plays any card. Subsequent players MUST follow the suit of the lead card if they have one. If a player has no cards of the lead suit, they may play ANY card (slough off fire cards or witches!). The highest card of the led suit wins the trick and collects all cards into their score pile. Wizard (0) can always be played regardless of suit, but never wins unless only wizards were played (first wizard wins).
official_witches_card_rules_reference.end_game_condition: Game ends at the end of the round where at least one player reaches 70 or more points. The player with the lowest score wins.

interactive_micro_interactions.card_hover: Hovering on a card slides it upward by 16px with an amber halo `shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)]`.
interactive_micro_interactions.card_play: Card animates in an arc from player hand to table center with a brief rotation (-15deg to +15deg based on seat position).
interactive_micro_interactions.trick_sweep: After a 1.2s delay, cards gathered into a stack and slide toward winning player's avatar icon with a score notification.
interactive_micro_interactions.witch_entrance: Whenever a special witch (Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Pygmy Queen) is dropped into the trick, a localized elemental flare appears with an evocative sound.
interactive_micro_interactions.pass_gate_privacy: Device passing screen completely blinds hand contents until clicked, preventing accidental glances.

implementation_steps_for_main_agent: Step 1: Install required icons/audio helper dependencies if needed (@phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react already installed). Add Google fonts (Cinzel, Outfit, JetBrains Mono) to public/index.html or @import in index.css.

Step 2: Build game state engine (`src/game/witchesEngine.js`): Deck generation (60 cards: 4 colors 1-14 + 4 Wizards), shuffle, deal according to player count (3 players = 20 cards each, 4 players = 15 each, 5 players = 12 each, 6 players = 10 each).
Step 3: Implement passing logic based on player count: 3 players = pass 3 left; 4 players = pass 3 (left/right/across/none); 5 players = pass 2 left; 6 players = pass 1 left.
Step 4: Implement trick-taking logic with Amigo rules: must follow suit if able, wizard can be played anytime, highest lead suit wins, trick winner leads next trick.

Step 5: Implement exact scoring calculator: tally fire cards (1 pt each), Fire Witch x2 (max 15), Water Witch +5, Pygmy Queen +10, Earth Witch -5, Air Witch cancels Water & Pygmy Queen. Implement shooting the moon (all 14 fire cards collected = 0 pts to shooter, 20/25/30 to all others!).
Step 6: Build the Cozy Cauldron Table UI with gorgeous SVG card components, fanned hand, pass device privacy screen, sounds, and scoreboard drawer.
Step 7: Build Local Stats persistence and Rules Grimoire dialog with comprehensive illustrations.
